## Core Technical Capabilities

- **Autonomous Sales Lead Pipelines (< 45s Speed-to-Lead Moat):** Interactive ROI diagnostic intake, automated company enrichment, sub-60s personalized WhatsApp/email outreach, value-stacking nurture drips, and bi-directional CRM synchronization (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Supabase).
- **Vision OMS & Document AI Parsing:** Multi-page PDF purchase order and invoice table extraction, deterministic JSON/Pydantic schema validation, line-item reconciliation, and ERP/database persistence.
- **Autonomous Marketing & Content Scaling:** Omnichannel content distribution (LinkedIn, X, Meta, newsletters), real-time retention telemetry, automated micro-budget ad boosting of top-10% organic winners, and competitor ad-library intelligence.
- **Outcome-Driven Business Development 2.0:** POPIA/GDPR-compliant operational telemetry that evaluates real deliverables against role-calibrated benchmarks without invasive employee spyware.
- **Mission-Critical Integration Infrastructure:** Self-hosted/enterprise n8n, Python/FastAPI microservices, Redis, PostgreSQL (Supabase), idempotency keys, exponential backoff retries, and automated Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) Slack/Telegram alerts.

## Engagement Models

1. **The 5-Day Pilot Sprint (Recommended Entry):** Fixed-scope, 5-business-day delivery of 1 self-contained production workflow (e.g., lead triage, PO parsing, CRM sync) with deterministic JSON schemas, DLQ alerting, mutual NDA, and a 14-day bugfix warranty.
2. **Core Pipeline Build:** End-to-end multi-stage automation overhaul across n8n, Supabase, FastAPI microservices, and Vision OCR with a 30-day post-deployment engineering warranty.
3. **Fractional Automation Lead:** Dedicated senior ML & backend automation retainer directly with Muzikayise Khuzwayo (capped at 3 concurrent clients) with 24/7 DLQ monitoring and continuous workflow creation.

## Verified Engineering Case Studies

- **Henry Cumines / Ulysses Group Ltd (Enterprise Logistics & OMS):** Architected Vision OMS purchase order and line-item extraction pipeline using n8n, Supabase, PDF.co, and Vision LLMs. Saved 15+ hours/week with 95% latency reduction and zero dropped POs. (Reference: Dave Leng)
- **PerformanceX / Digital Authority Partners (Enterprise SaaS & Analytics):** Head of Integrations & Automation Engineer. Built FastAPI and CRM sync client intake pipelines with continuous prompt feedback loops, accelerating client onboarding velocity by 60%. (Reference: Michael Reddy, Partner)
- **Levatus i Norden AB (Nordic Real Estate & FinTech):** Engineered automated invoice reconciliation and conversational multi-channel real estate CRM in n8n + Roboflow, cutting lead response time from 6 hours to under 60 seconds. (Reference: Walid Valerius Namro)
- **Dubstrata & Simulacra UAT (Autonomous Systems & Causal AI Research):** Engineered autonomous persona-based UAT testing framework and authored peer-reviewed foundation model architecture *Dubstrata Causal-FM* on SSRN (Abstract IDs: 7528238 & 7377639).
